max_jerk.method: Three equal-duration rest-to-rest minimum-jerk spherical-coordinate phases: rise to declared terrain/subject top, sweep, settle. Constant look target at declared subject center. Use the largest conservative analytic Cartesian jerk bound. No solver data or calibration factor.

description: Deterministic smooth Gaussian summit; the declared subject includes buried ground and its visible summit envelope.
intent_evidence: Reveal finishes above its starting altitude.
name: terrain_attached_mountain
provenance: Authored deterministic local heightfields; no downloaded terrain, RNG, or render golden.
